title: Research
text: My research is in probability and stochastic analysis, with a particular focus on directed polymers, stochastic partial differential equations, and the KPZ universality class.

title: Research
text:
Research Interests

Directed polymers in random environments
Stochastic heat equation and Parabolic Anderson model
KPZ universality
Intermediate disorder for directed polymers
Wiener chaos and stochastic analysis

title: Teaching
text:
During my time at the University of Rochester, I have been instructor of record in five terms, including Calculus II this semester, Linear Algebra and Differential Equations (online), and Introduction to Probability (online). I have also led workshops for calculus courses over four semesters, where students rated my teaching 4.57/5 overall (58 respondents).
This semester, I am also leading an undergraduate reading course on the combinatorics of the simple random walk.

title: Roan James
text:
University of Rochester
I am a PhD student in the Department of Mathematics at the University of Rochester, supervised by Professor Arjun Krishnan. I expect to complete my PhD in May 2027 and am currently on the job market for postdoctoral and teaching positions.
My research lies in stochastic analysis, with a particular focus on directed polymers in intermediate disorder and the stochastic heat equation.
CV Academic CV

title: Roan James
text:
Current Research
My thesis studies scaling limits of directed polymer models and their connections with stochastic partial differential equations.
Preprint: R. A. James and A. Krishnan, Directed Polymers in an External Field at Intermediate Disorder. In preparation; expected on arXiv in November 2026.

title: Roan James
text:
Undergraduate Education
I received an MMath in Mathematics from the University of Sheffield, graduating with First Class Honours. During my final year, I was awarded the T. M. Flett Prize for achieving the highest marks in Pure Mathematics.
Degree Certificate T. M. Flett Prize

title: Roan James
text:
Service
I am the president of the AMS Graduate Student Chapter at the University of Rochester. This semester, the chapter has held panel discussions on careers for mathematics graduate students and on the future of mathematics with AI.

title: Roan James
text:
Projects

PAM-Driven Volatility and Option Pricing
A computational notebook exploring a toy connection between the parabolic Anderson model (stochastic heat equation) and volatility modelling in option pricing.
